verdict.rationale: Base44 documents several first-party MCP servers. One exposes the user's Base44 account to any MCP-compatible assistant (base44-docs-38). App MCP gives each published app its own MCP server that Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor can connect to (base44-docs-7). A Docs MCP server lets assistants search the documentation (base44-docs-39). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP servers working, and documented detail on exposed tools, auth and setup in the cited snippets.
